entry.title: Hohenzollern Castle

groundCutout.basis: 2.02 m buffered fresh lowest road/covered segments and interpreted Eagle gate body. The bounded opening clears coarse host terrain from owned low entrance deck surfaces. Any interior island is reconstructed at the retained coarse grade by the model. Upper court, bastion interior and mountain remain uncut.

entry.note: Fresh exact-Q156457 enclosure way 93612350 v51 and 43 mapped parts use native +X ESE at 104.564815 degrees, +Z SSW at 194.564815 degrees, heading -0.254203978258. Several shared entrance nodes changed since the original source: up to 12.203 m nearest-vertex displacement is recorded as a map-version difference. The independent derivative uses fresh geometry; original evidence and recipe remain reproducible. Eagle and upper gate passage centers/bearings follow the mapped covered roads. Retained coarse numeric terrain has a 4225-value 4 m native grid and decoded anchor working datum 835.9281 m. One rigid -10.4563 m shift meets mapped approach grade +0.08 m; court is 19.5437 m above anchor. The 30 m relative entry-to-court rise remains a reconstruction supported by independent 825/855 map tags, not a connected vertical survey. Only the lowest owned entrance roads and Eagle gate use a 434.096-square-meter ground cut; its enclosed island retains sampled grade. Upper court and mountain remain uncut. Mapped structural skirts extend four meters below retained terrain. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
